title: Trading bot operates under a capability token only
operational_setting: A trading bot receives a capability allowing trades within asset, amount and time limits and executes deterministic signals.
trust_boundary: The bot can move capital through an external broker.
intended_transition: Permitted trade is executed within risk bounds.

attack.procedure: Use a standard capability representation as the sole authority mechanism and test whether ART adds any independent information beyond the capability semantics.

success_criteria_for_attack: If capability semantics fully encode scope, validity, delegation and revocation needs, a separate ART authority construct is redundant in this scope.

verdict.rationale: Tests whether ART should defer entirely to capability systems for authority.
